summary: Mixed legal and retail day with one major court ruling and two concrete earnings impacts. Bombay High Court targets festival firecracker regulation; Samsung India reports 36% profit decline despite revenue growth.

bullets.text: Bombay High Court proposes decibel caps and bans firecrackers on streets during festivals to prevent deaths.
Delhi High Court begins hearing Mastercard tax dispute afresh after eight years across nine benches.
Samsung India Electronics profit fell 36% to Rs 7,228 crore in FY26; revenue rose 1.2% to Rs 1.12 lakh crore.
Parag Milk Foods quadrupling paneer capacity from 20 MT/day to 80 MT/day for retail and e-commerce expansion.
India-New Zealand FTA ratified, effective October 20.
